\paragraph{Verdict on H1.2.} H1.2 is supported within a clearly bounded scope. For distillation on the MSMARCO passage collection, evaluated on the associated TREC DL and BEIR benchmarks, BM25-sampled negatives are statistically equivalent to expensively mined negatives under a paired TOST at a $1\%$ margin ($\theta = 0.01\,\mu_{\text{baseline}}$, $\alpha = 0.05$), for both bi-encoders and cross-encoders, in-domain and out-of-domain. The density-ratio analysis explains why: the operative factors are teacher pairwise entropy and the essential diameter of the query manifold, neither of which the mining cascade tightens enough to register.
